'''Amenoshirahano Shrine''' (天志良波神社) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Hitachiōta, Ibaraki|en|Hitachiōta, Ibaraki|qid=Q838663|lt=Hitachiota, Ibaraki}} in {{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki Prefecture}}, Japan. It is an {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchōqq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}-listed shrine with the former shrine Rank of {{ill|Gōsha|ja|郷社qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq=}}. The shrine enshrines {{ill|Nagashirahano no Kami|ja|長白羽神qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagashirahano no Kami|qq=}}, also known as Amenoshirahano no Mikoto. The annual festival is held on {{ill|April 10th|en|4月10日qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/April 10th|qq=}}.
== History ==
The exact time of establishment is unknown. The shrine was elevated to Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade (従五位下) in the 8th year of the Jōgan era (866) and later promoted to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade (従五位上) in the 16th year of the same era (874). In the 13th year of the Tenbun era (1544), the shrine's buildings were repaired under the patronage of {{ill|Satake Yoshitoku|ja|佐竹義篤 (十六代当主)qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Satake Yoshitoku|qq=}}. During the 15th year of the Tenpō era (1844), the shrine was designated as the guardian shrine for five nearby villages, including Shiraha, under the sponsorship of the {{ill|Mito Domain|en|Mito Domain|qid=Q1146904|lt=Mito Domain}}.
